items.source: Any annotation meta-annotated with @Component is considered a stereotype annotation which makes the annotated class eligible for classpath scanning. For example, @Service, @Controller, and @Repository are stereotype annotations. Stereotype annotations may also support configuration of a logical component name by overriding the value() attribute of this annotation via @AliasFor.
items.translation: 任何使用 `@Component` 进行元注解的注解都被视为立体标记(stereotype) 注解，这使得被注解的类有资格进行类路径扫描。例如，@Service、@Controller 和 @Repository 都是立体标记注解。立体标记注解还可以通过使用 @AliasFor 覆盖此注解的 value() 属性来支持逻辑组件名称的配置。

items.source: As of Spring Framework 6.1, support for configuring the name of a stereotype component by convention (i.e., via a String value() attribute without @AliasFor) is deprecated and will be removed in a future version of the framework. Consequently, custom stereotype annotations must use @AliasFor to declare an explicit alias for this annotation's value() attribute. See the source code declaration of Repository.value() and ControllerAdvice.name() for concrete examples.
items.translation: 自 Spring Framework 6.1 起，通过约定配置立体类型组件名称的支持（即在没有使用@AliasFor的情况下，通过String value()属性）已被弃用，并将在框架的将来版本中移除。因此，自定义立体类型注解必须使用@AliasFor来声明该注解的value()属性的显式别名。有关具体示例，请参阅Repository.value()和ControllerAdvice.name()的源代码声明。Repository.value()和ControllerAdvice.name()

items.source: Other class-level annotations may be considered as identifying a component as well, typically a special kind of component — for example, the @Repository annotation or AspectJ's @Aspect annotation. Note, however, that the @Aspect annotation does not automatically make a class eligible for classpath scanning.
items.translation: 其他类级别注解也可能被视为标识组件，通常是特殊类型的组件——例如，`org.springframework.stereotype` 包中的@Repository注解或 AspectJ 的@Aspect注解。然而请注意，@Aspect注解并不会自动使类符合类路径扫描的条件。

items.source: A component may optionally specify a logical component name via the value attribute of this annotation.
items.translation: 组件可以通过此注解的 value 属性可选地指定逻辑组件名称。

items.source:
Such classes are considered as candidates for auto-detection
when using annotation-based configuration and classpath scanning.
items.translation: 此类在基于注解的配置和类路径扫描时，被视为自动检测的候选项。

items.source:
The value may indicate a suggestion for a logical component name,
to be turned into a Spring bean name in case of an autodetected component.
items.translation: 该值可能表示逻辑组件名称的建议，在检测到自动组件时将其转换为 Spring  Bean 名称。

items.source: the suggested component name, if any (or empty String otherwise)
items.translation: 建议的组件名称（如果有，否则为空字符串）
